title: 部分回款与退税收汇材料
summary_zh: 第四十八至五十一条规定收汇期限、视同收汇及证据要求。次年4月30日规则包含合同最终收汇日期等条件与例外，不能直接套成所有订单的截止日。
summary_en: Articles 48–51 connect export tax relief to collection and evidence, including bank or FX receipt records and specified deemed-collection cases. Contract-date exceptions and the stated outer limit must be checked together with the ordinary deadline.
tradex_workflow: Compare the payment email with contract and bank records, ask for the missing receipt date or evidence, and propose a conditional collection follow-up.
cash_effect: An email promise updates expected collection; only accepted receipt evidence updates actual cash.
title_en: Partial receipts and export refund evidence

部分回款与退税收汇材料
第四十八至五十一条规定收汇期限、视同收汇及证据要求。次年4月30日规则包含合同最终收汇日期等条件与例外，不能直接套成所有订单的截止日。
Articles 48–51 connect export tax relief to collection and evidence, including bank or FX receipt records and specified deemed-collection cases. Contract-date exceptions and the stated outer limit must be checked together with the ordinary deadline.
